protocol.name: independent_v1_family_source_only_oof_temperature_calibration_v1
protocol.source_splits: Exact parent source trials only. Leave one source subject out per OOF fold: ROAM subjects 1-18, GRAB same-day source subjects 1-4, GRAB cross-day Day1 subjects 1-8. Each fold refits F0v2 Rest thresholds, StandardScaler and LogisticRegression on other source subjects; candidate feature metadata depend only on channel count, sample rate and window length.
protocol.classifier: Same C=1 max_iter=2000 and study-specific class weights/seeds as frozen parent screens
protocol.calibrator: One positive scalar temperature per study/arm, fitted on source subject-held-out OOF probabilities only; grid {1.0} union geomspace(0.5,5.0,61), minimize source OOF log loss with tie-break toward 1.0. Clip input probabilities to 1e-12 and renormalize softmax(log(p)/T). Target labels never select T.
protocol.evaluation: Apply source-selected T to the five frozen validation/final arm probability vectors on exactly matched native targets. Compare log loss, Brier and ten-bin ECE against uncalibrated; macro-F1 is mathematically invariant for positive scalar T and is checked. Validation selects no new classifier arm after seeing final.
protocol.scope: Public zero-target-shot probability calibration on three correlated ROAM/GRAB screens. This tests calibration sensitivity of independently defined families; it is not personal 0/1/2/5-shot calibration and not own-device validation.
